reviews.reviewText: Very good tractor for field work. Engine torque and fuel mileage during puddling was top notch. Owner was helpful and equipment was maintained well.
High precision hydraulics made rotavator operation effortless. On-time doorstep delivery by owner.
Good machine condition and operator was skilled. Minor delay in transport arrival but overall great experience.
John Deere 5310 is unbeatable in heavy clay soils. Smooth dual-clutch transmission and zero breakdown.
Rubber tracks worked wonders in wet paddy land without sinking. Grain loss was less than 1%. Highly recommended!
Shaktiman rotavator pulverized black soil into fine tilth in a single pass. Boron steel blades are sharp and strong.
Sprayed 10 acres of cotton crop in under an hour. Saved 90% water and prevented direct chemical contact. Amazing tech!
